row:
Welcome to Marigold Hope Massage, a Clinical Massage Therapy channel focused on evidence-based bodywork and musculoskeletal rehabilitation.
We specialize in Deep Tissue Massage, Myofascial Release, Trigger Point Therapy, Lymphatic Drainage, Swedish Massage, and corrective soft tissue techniques. Our content covers anatomy education, palpation skills, pain management, posture correction, fascia release, and muscle recovery protocols.
This channel is designed for massage therapists, students, health professionals, and individuals seeking professional therapeutic massage knowledge.
Subscribe for clinical demonstrations, structured treatment approaches, and advanced manual therapy techniques.
